intro: A 1960s-style 427 roadster, designed and built in Sri Lanka by Donnavann Dax Rajasegar. Eleven years in the making, with 80% local value addition.

stats.label: Years to build the first car
Presented to the President of Sri Lanka

story: Segar Motorsports builds brand-new sports cars inspired by the world's most timeless designs. The first is the Segar Cobra: a two-seat roadster in the spirit of the 1960s 427 race cars.

Its creator, Donnavann Dax Rajasegar, spent eleven years building it in Sri Lanka. The steel chassis and the fibreglass body were made here, together with the roll bar, dashboard, centre console and brackets, using raw materials sourced within the country. The car is built in collaboration with RV Dynamics.

features.title: Twin racing stripes
features.text: Gloss black with silver stripes over the bonnet, cockpit and boot.

features.title: Side exhausts
features.text: Chrome side pipes running beneath the doors.

features.title: Roll bar
features.text: Chrome roll bar behind the cockpit, made in Sri Lanka.

features.title: Segar wheels
features.text: Spoked wheels with Segar centre caps.

features.title: Limited-slip differential
features.text: An LSD sends power to both rear wheels for grip out of corners.

features.title: Classic cockpit
features.text: Wood-rim steering wheel, seven analogue gauges and toggle switches, with Bluetooth.

milestones.title: Technical evaluation
milestones.text: The Technology Incubator of the National Engineering Research and Development Centre (NERDC) evaluated the car's structure, performance, stability and safety features. Its report found that the car meets or exceeds the technical and safety requirements of the Department of Motor Traffic, making it eligible for registration.

milestones.title: Presented to the President
milestones.text: The car was presented to President Ranil Wickremesinghe at the Presidential Secretariat in Colombo.

milestones.title: Ministry of Industries
milestones.text: Scheduled for exhibition at the Ministry of Industries as a car designed and manufactured in Sri Lanka.

milestones.title: On the road
milestones.text: The Segar Cobra is registered and driven on Sri Lankan roads, from Galle Fort to the coast.
